title: Stairway to Heaven
hook: Why Stairway to Heaven *starts by walking down*

chords.name: Am
chords.text: Home: *A minor*. Quiet, like an old story.

chords.name: Am/G#
chords.text: The bass slips to *G♯*. A shiver.

chords.name: C/G
chords.text: Down again to *G*. The floor keeps sinking.

chords.name: D/F#
chords.text: *F♯* in the bass: a brief, sad warmth.

chords.name: Fmaj7
chords.text: *Fmaj7*: five steps down, soft and sad.

question: Did you learn this intro on guitar? Be honest 👇
